purpose: shadow learning labels for intraday candidate redesign

marketLessons.lesson: Do not rely on daily change-rate top-N only.
marketLessons.evidence: Samsung Electronics was a large-liquid momentum candidate with low opening gap and +10.09% close, but can be missed by small change-rate top-N filters.

marketLessons.lesson: Pre-open and opening gap scan must run before normal intraday scanner.
marketLessons.evidence: LG Electronics first valid minute at 09:02 was already +25.94% versus previous close and hit limit-up at 09:08.

marketLessons.lesson: When the leader is already high-gap limit-up, prefer theme proxy candidates with lower gap and stronger intraday room.
marketLessons.evidence: LG Electronics opened near limit-up, while LG HelloVision and LG Electronics preferred had better intraday efficiency.

marketLessons.lesson: Theme spread must be modeled as a cluster, not as isolated symbols.
marketLessons.evidence: LG group, robot, AI and automation names moved together around Nvidia/LG/Samsung robot automation narratives.

labels.modelAction: watch before open; avoid blind chase after +25%; use proxy or pullback-relock
promote to ENTRY_READY on +5% break with trade-amount rank and VWAP confirmation
prefer over high-gap LG Electronics after LG theme confirms
candidate when common share is locked or near limit-up
pre-open only; do not chase after full gap
penalize weak follow-through even inside strong theme
